byline.ar: الشيخ الدكتور وليد بن إدريس المنيسي
byline.en: By Shaykh Dr Waleed ibn Idris al-Meneese
On the danger of temptations, and how mistakes taken lightly damage the heart over time

items.en: Effects of temptations on the hearts

blocks.ar: الخطبة الأولى
blocks.en: The First Khuṭbah

blocks.ar: الحمد لله والصلاة والسلام على رسول الله وبعد:
blocks.en: All praise is due to Allah, and peace and blessings be upon the Messenger of Allah. To proceed:

blocks.ar: تأثير الفتن على القلوب
blocks.en: Effects of Temptations on the Hearts

blocks.ar: عن حذيفة بن اليمان قال رسول الله ﷺ:
blocks.en: Ḥudhayfah ibn al-Yamān (may Allah be pleased with him) narrated that the Messenger of Allah ﷺ said:

blocks.ar: «تعرض الفتن على القلوب كعرض الحصير عوداً عوداً فأي قلب أشربها نكتت فيه نكتة سوداء وأي قلب أنكرها نكتت فيه نكتة بيضاء حتى تعود القلوب على قلبين قلب أسود مرباداً كالكوز مجخياً لا يعرف معروفاً ولا ينكر منكراً إلا ما أشرب من هواه، وقلب أبيض لا تضره فتنة ما دامت السموات والأرض»
blocks.en: “Temptations will be presented to the hearts as a reed mat is woven, stick by stick, and any heart which is impregnated by them (temptations) will have a black mark put into it, but any heart which rejects them will have a white mark put in it. The result is that there will be two types of hearts: one like a dusty, black-colored, tilted (inverted) cup, not recognizing what is good nor rejecting what is abominable, but being impregnated with passion; and the other (type of heart) white, which will not be harmed by any turmoil or temptation so long as the heavens and the earth endure.”

blocks.ar: بيّن النبي ﷺ حال القلوب عندما تتعرض للفتن، والفتن نوعان:
blocks.en: The Prophet ﷺ described the conditions of the hearts when they are exposed to the two types of temptation as follows:

blocks.ar: فتن الشهوات التي تحول بين العبد وبين طاعة أمر الله ورسوله،
blocks.en: The temptation of following one’s desires, which intervenes between the servant and his answering the commands of Allah and His Messenger ﷺ.

blocks.ar: وفتن الشبهات التي تحول بين العبد وبين تصديق خبر الله ورسوله.
blocks.en: And the temptation of indulging in doubtful (suspicious) things, which intervenes between the servant and his ability (willingness) to believe in what reaches him from Allah and His Messenger.

blocks.ar: فبين أن الفتن تؤثر في القلب كتأثير أعواد الحصير في جنب النائم عليه، فالقلب الذي أُشْرب الفتنة أي تخللته الفتنة كما يتخلل الشراب في الإسفنج ظهرت عليه علامة سوداء ثم ظلت هذه العلامات السود تزداد حتى يصبح هذا القلب أسود وفي لونه رُبْدة وهي لون بين السواد والغبرة كالكوز المقلوب لا ينفذ إلى داخله نور ولا ضياء.
blocks.en: He (the Messenger of Allah ﷺ) gave as an example that the effects of temptation on the hearts are like the marks (prints) a reed mat leaves on the side of the person who sleeps on it. So the heart that is impregnated (infiltrated) with temptations is like a sponge filled with water. Such a heart will have a black mark appear in it first, followed by many similar black marks, until the whole heart becomes black, the color of rubdah (rubdah is a color between black and the color of dust). The example of this type of heart is an overturned cup into which no light enters.

blocks.ar: وأما القلب الذي أنكر الفتنة ورفضها واعتصم بالله تعالى فإنه تظهر عليه علامة بيضاء ثم تزداد هذه العلامات البيض حتى يتحول قلبه إلى قلب أبيض منير لا تضره فتنة ما دامت السموات والأرض.
blocks.en: In contrast, the heart that rejects temptations and stays firmly connected to Allah will have a white mark appear in it, followed by many similar (white) marks, until it becomes a luminous (shining) white that resists all temptations so long as the heavens and the earth endure.

blocks.ar: عن أبي هريرة قال رسول الله ﷺ:
blocks.en: It was narrated by Abū Hurayrah (may Allah be pleased with him) that the Messenger of Allah ﷺ said:

blocks.ar: «إن المؤمن إذا أذنب ذنباً كانت نكتةٌ سوداء في قلبه فإن تاب ونزع واستعتب صُقل قلبه وإن زاد زادت حتى تعلو قلبه فذلك الران الذي قال تعالى: ﴿كلا بل ران على قلوبهم ما كانوا يكسبون﴾»
blocks.en: “When the believer commits a sin, a black spot appears on his heart. If he repents, gives up that sin and seeks forgiveness, his heart will be polished. But if (the sin) increases, (the black spot) increases. That is the rān that Allah mentions in His Book: ‘Nay! But on their hearts is the rān (covering of sins and evil deeds) which they used to earn.’”

blocks.ar: أنواع القلوب
blocks.en: Types of the Hearts

blocks.ar: وعن أبي سعيد الخدري قال رسول الله ﷺ:
blocks.en: Abū Saʿīd al-Khudrī (may Allah be pleased with him) reported that the Messenger of Allah ﷺ said:

blocks.ar: «القلوب أربعة: قلب أجرد فيه مثل السراج يزهر وقلبٌ أغلف مربوطٌ على غلافه وقلب منكوس وقلب مصفح فأما القلب الأجرد فقلب مؤمن فسراجه فيه نوره وأما القلب الأغلف فقلب الكافر وأما القلب المنكوس فقلب المنافق الخالص عرف ثم أنكر وأما القلب المصفح فقلب فيه إيمان ونفاق ومثل الإيمان فيه كمثل البقلة يمدها الماء الطيب ومثل النفاق فيه كمثل القرحة يمدها القيح والدم فأي المادتين غلبت على الأخرى غلبت عليه»
blocks.en: “Hearts are of four kinds: the heart that is clear like a shining lamp; the heart that is covered and tied up; the heart that is upside-down; and the heart that is clad in armor. As for the clear heart, it is the heart of the believer, in which is a lamp filled with light. As for the covered heart, this is the heart of the disbeliever. As for the upside-down heart, this is the heart of the hypocrite, who recognizes and then denies. As for the armor-clad heart, this is the heart in which there is both faith and hypocrisy. The parable of the faith in it is that of a legume, a sprout that is irrigated with good water, and the likeness of the hypocrisy in it is that of sores that are fed by blood and pus. Whichever of the two prevails is the characteristic that will dominate.”

ref.ar: رواه أحمد وحسنه ابن كثير في تفسيره 1/87
ref.en: Narrated by Aḥmad; graded good by Ibn Kathīr in his Tafsīr (1/87)

blocks.ar: قال تعالى:
blocks.en: Allah said, in what translates as:

blocks.ar: ﴿إن السمع والبصر والفؤاد كل أولئك كان عنه مسؤولاً﴾
blocks.en: “Indeed, the hearing, the sight and the heart—about all those [one] will be questioned.”

blocks.ar: وعن النعمان بن بشير رضي الله عنهما قال رسول الله ﷺ:
blocks.en: Al-Nuʿmān ibn Bashīr (may Allah be pleased with them both) narrated that the Messenger of Allah ﷺ said:

blocks.ar: «ألا وإن في الجسد مضغة إذا صلحت صلح الجسد كله وإذا فسدت فسد الجسد كله ألا وهي القلب»
blocks.en: “Beware! There is a piece of flesh in the body: if it becomes good (reformed), the whole body becomes good, but if it gets spoiled, the whole body gets spoiled. And that is the heart.”

blocks.ar: وقد بين الله سبحانه في كتابه الكريم أن القلوب على ثلاثة أقسام:
blocks.en: Allah described in His Book (the Qurʾān) that hearts are of three classes:

blocks.ar: أ- القلب السليم
blocks.en: a) The sound heart

blocks.ar: الذي سلم من أمراض الشبهات ومن أمراض الشهوات، وهو القلب الذي لا ينجو يوم القيامة إلا من جاء به، قال تعالى:
blocks.en: It is free of the diseases of suspicions and temptations. None will be safe on the Day of Judgment except the one who comes with this type of heart (a sound heart). Allah said, in what translates as:

blocks.ar: ﴿يوم لا ينفع مال ولا بنون إلا من أتى الله بقلب سليم﴾
blocks.en: “The Day when there will not benefit [anyone] wealth or children, but only one who comes to Allah with a sound heart.”

blocks.ar: وقال تعالى عن إبراهيم عليه السلام:
blocks.en: Allah also said about Ibrāhīm (peace be upon him), in what translates as:

blocks.ar: ﴿إذ جاء ربه بقلب سليم﴾
blocks.en: “When he came to his Lord with a sound heart.”

blocks.ar: ب- القلب الميت
blocks.en: b) The dead heart

blocks.ar: وهو قلب الكافر وقد صار عليه غلاف يمنع وصول الحق إليه، قال تعالى:
blocks.en: This is the heart of the disbeliever. It is wrapped in a cover that prevents the truth from reaching it. Allah said, in what translates as:

blocks.ar: ﴿وقولهم قلوبنا غلف بل طبع الله عليها بكفرهم فلا يؤمنون إلا قليلاً﴾
blocks.en: “And their saying, ‘Our hearts are wrapped.’ Rather, Allah has sealed them because of their disbelief, so they believe not, except for a few.”

blocks.ar: وهو القلب القاسي، قال تعالى:
blocks.en: This is an example of the hard heart, as Allah said, in what translates as:

blocks.ar: ﴿ثم قست قلوبكم من بعد ذلك فهي كالحجارة أو أشد قسوة﴾
blocks.en: “Then your hearts became hardened after that, being like stones or even harder.”

blocks.ar: ج- القلب المريض
blocks.en: c) The sick heart

blocks.ar: بمرض الشهوات كما في قوله تعالى:
blocks.en: It is infected with the disease of desires, as Allah described it, in what translates as:

blocks.ar: ﴿فَلا تَخْضَعْنَ بِالْقَوْلِ فَيَطْمَعَ الَّذِي فِي قَلْبِهِ مَرَضٌ﴾
blocks.en: “Then do not be soft in speech [to men], lest he in whose heart is disease should covet.”

blocks.ar: أو بمرض الشبهات كما في قوله تعالى:
blocks.en: Or it is a heart infected with doubts and suspicions. Allah said, in what translates as:

blocks.ar: ﴿وَإِذَا دُعُوا إِلَى اللَّهِ وَرَسُولِهِ لِيَحْكُمَ بَيْنَهُمْ إِذَا فَرِيقٌ مِنْهُمْ مُعْرِضُونَ ۝ وَإِنْ يَكُنْ لَهُمْ الْحَقُّ يَأْتُوا إِلَيْهِ مُذْعِنِينَ ۝ أَفِي قُلُوبِهِمْ مَرَضٌ أَمْ ارْتَابُوا أَمْ يَخَافُونَ أَنْ يَحِيفَ اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِمْ وَرَسُولُهُ بَلْ أُوْلَئِكَ هُمْ الظَّالِمُونَ﴾
blocks.en: “And when they are called to Allah and His Messenger so that he may judge between them, at once a party of them turns away. But if the right is on their side, they come to him in ready submission. Is there disease in their hearts? Or have they doubted? Or do they fear that Allah will be unjust to them, or His Messenger? Rather, it is they who are the wrongdoers.”

blocks.ar: قال عبد الله بن المبارك رحمه الله:
blocks.en: ʿAbdullāh ibn al-Mubārak (may Allah have mercy on him) said, in verse:

blocks.ar:
رأيت الذنوب تميت القلوب
وقد يورث الذل إدمانها

وترك الذنوب حياة القلوب
وخير لنفسك عصيانها
blocks.en:
I noticed that sins cause death to the hearts…
…and becoming addicted to them brings about humiliation.

And the abandonment of sins is life for the hearts…
…so it is best for your self to disobey them (sins).

blocks.ar: علامات مرض القلب
blocks.en: Signs of the Heart’s Sickness

blocks.ar: إن لمرض القلوب أعراضاً وعلامات منها: تقديم العبد حظه وشهوته على طاعة ربه ومحبته، قال تعالى:
blocks.en: Surely, the disease of the hearts has symptoms and signs. Among them: the person gives preference to temptations and desires over his love for his Lord and his obedience to Him. Allah said in the Qurʾān, in what translates as:

blocks.ar: ﴿أرأيت من اتخذ إلهه هواه أفأنت تكون عليه وكيلاً﴾
blocks.en: “Have you seen the one who takes as his god his own desire? Then would you be responsible for him?”

blocks.ar: قال بعض السلف: هو الذي كلما هوى شيئاً ركبه.
blocks.en: One of the Salaf said: He is the one who, whenever he desires something, goes after it.

blocks.ar: ومن العلامات: أن صاحبه لا تؤلمه جراحات المعاصي كما قيل: وما لجرح بميت إيلام، فالقلب الصحيح السليم يتوجع بالمعصية ويتألم كما قال تعالى:
blocks.en: Also among the symptoms and signs: the person who is infected does not feel the danger and the pain that come with committing sins; as it was said, “Wounds [cuts] don’t cause pain to the dead.” The healthy and sound heart, on the other hand, feels pain and suffers when a sin is committed. Allah said, in what translates as:

blocks.ar: ﴿إن الذين اتقوا إذا مسهم طائف من الشيطان تذكروا فإذا هم مبصرون﴾
blocks.en: “Indeed, those who fear Allah—when an impulse touches them from Satan, they remember [Him] and at once they have insight.”

blocks.ar: ومنها: الإعراض عن الأغذية النافعة للقلب كتلاوة القرآن وذكر الله وطاعته والعلم النافع، واستبدالها بالسموم القاتلة للقلب كسماع الغناء والمحرمات والنظر إلى ما حرم الله.
blocks.en: And among them: turning away from the spiritual nourishment that the heart needs, by abandoning the Qurʾān, the remembrance of Allah, obedience to Allah and the seeking of beneficial knowledge. Instead, the person replaces this nourishment of the heart with poisons that kill it, such as listening to music and singing and other unlawful things like them, as well as looking (staring) at what Allah has made unlawful to look at.

blocks.ar: أيها المسلمون: إن الإنسان إذا مرض قلبه فلم يبادر بالعلاج وتناول الدواء واستمر على تعاطي ما يزيد في مرضه يوشك أن يموت قلبه.
blocks.en: O Muslims, if a person’s heart is infected by these diseases and he does not hurry to remedy it and take the appropriate medicines, but instead continues to feed the heart every poison that causes disease, this heart will soon end up dead.

blocks.ar: اللهم يا مقلب القلوب ثبت قلوبنا على دينك.
blocks.en: O Allah, Turner of the hearts, make our hearts firm upon Your religion.

blocks.ar: اللهم آمين.
blocks.en: O Allah, āmīn.

blocks.ar: والحمد لله رب العالمين.
blocks.en: And praise is to Allah, the Lord of the worlds.

blocks.ar: الخطبة الثانية
blocks.en: The Second Khuṭbah
